-- =============================================================================
-- CONSOLIDATED BIGQUERY SQL: CV_COMP_SKF_MANUAL_JE
-- Final Consumer: CV_COMP_SKF_MANUAL_JE
-- Generated by: BigQuery SQL Consolidation Agent
-- Runtime Parameters:
--   @ip_week_ending_from  STRING  -- Fiscal week start (e.g. '202301'); maps to ZZWEEK >= @ip_week_ending_from
--   @ip_week_ending_to    STRING  -- Fiscal week end   (e.g. '202352'); maps to ZZWEEK <= @ip_week_ending_to
--   @ip_version_comp_flag STRING  -- Comparison flag version; maps to COMP_VER = @ip_version_comp_flag
-- =============================================================================

WITH

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 1: FAGLSKF_PN_S4
-- Logic: Projects and filters statistical key figure ledger data from
--        the physical FAGLSKF_PN table. Applies client, STAGR, week
--        range, and source-code filters as defined in CV_BASE_SKF_FAGLSKF_PN_S4
--        and the consumer filter nodes of CV_COMP_SKF_MANUAL_JE.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_faglskf_pn
-- Filters: rclnt IN ('120','200') [STRING per BQ_DATATYPE]
--          stagr IN ('801000','804013')
--          zzweek >= @ip_week_ending_from AND zzweek <= @ip_week_ending_to  [STRING]
--          zzscode != 'SLS'
-- =====================================================================
FAGLSKF_PN_S4 AS (
  SELECT
    rclnt,
    stagr,
    date_from,
    msl,
    prctr,
    zzscode,
    zzweek,
    rcntr
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_faglskf_pn`
  WHERE rclnt IN ('120', '200')
    AND stagr IN ('801000', '804013')
    AND zzweek >= @ip_week_ending_from
    AND zzweek <= @ip_week_ending_to
    AND zzscode != 'SLS'
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 2: HIER
-- Logic: Projects HR Reporting Node hierarchy rows from the physical
--        HRRP_NODE table. Applies client filter from CV_BASE_MD_HRRP_NODE_S4
--        and the consumer filter: PARNODE matching '*CORERET*' and
--        HRYVALTO = DATE '9999-12-31' (DATS '99991231' → DATE type per mapping).
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_hrrp_node
-- Filters: mandt IN ('120','200') [STRING per BQ_DATATYPE]
--          REGEXP_CONTAINS(parnode, r'.*CORERET.*')
--          hryvalto = DATE '9999-12-31'  [DATE per BQ_DATATYPE]
-- =====================================================================
HIER AS (
  SELECT
    parnode,
    hryvalto,
    nodevalue
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_hrrp_node`
  WHERE mandt IN ('120', '200')
    AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(parnode, r'.*CORERET.*')
    AND hryvalto = DATE '9999-12-31'
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 3: Joined_FAGLSKF_with_HIER
-- Logic: INNER JOIN of FAGLSKF_PN_S4 and HIER on rcntr = nodevalue,
--        as defined by Join_7 in CV_COMP_SKF_MANUAL_JE. Retains all
--        FAGLSKF_PN_S4 attributes needed downstream.
-- Source: FAGLSKF_PN_S4, HIER
-- Join: INNER JOIN FAGLSKF_PN_S4 f ON f.rcntr = h.nodevalue
-- =====================================================================
Joined_FAGLSKF_with_HIER AS (
  SELECT
    f.rclnt,
    f.stagr,
    f.date_from,
    f.msl,
    f.prctr,
    f.zzweek,
    f.rcntr,
    f.zzscode
  FROM FAGLSKF_PN_S4 f
  INNER JOIN HIER h
    ON f.rcntr = h.nodevalue
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 4: STORE_ATTR_SKF_JOURNAL_ENT
-- Logic: Projects store attribute master data from ZTSRP_ATTR_ACT.
--        Applies client filter from CV_BASE_MD_SRPACT_S4. Only columns
--        consumed by CV_COMP_SKF_MANUAL_JE are projected.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_attr_act
-- Filters: mandt IN ('120','200') [STRING per BQ_DATATYPE]
-- =====================================================================
STORE_ATTR_SKF_JOURNAL_ENT AS (
  SELECT
    prctr,
    strnum,
    rep_mkt_code,
    rep_mkt_desc,
    city,
    state,
    division_code,
    division_desc,
    area_code,
    area_desc,
    region_code,
    region_desc,
    district_code,
    district_desc,
    emerg_mkt_ind,
    fs_open_dat,
    rx_open_dat,
    rx_division_code,
    rx_area_code,
    rx_region_code,
    rx_district_code
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_attr_act`
  WHERE mandt IN ('120', '200')
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 5: Joined_FAGLSKF_HIER_with_STORE_ATTR
-- Logic: LEFT OUTER JOIN of Joined_FAGLSKF_with_HIER and
--        STORE_ATTR_SKF_JOURNAL_ENT on prctr, as defined by Join_2
--        in CV_COMP_SKF_MANUAL_JE.
-- Source: Joined_FAGLSKF_with_HIER, STORE_ATTR_SKF_JOURNAL_ENT
-- Join: LEFT JOIN on f.prctr = s.prctr
-- =====================================================================
Joined_FAGLSKF_HIER_with_STORE_ATTR AS (
  SELECT
    f.rclnt,
    f.stagr,
    f.date_from,
    f.msl,
    f.prctr,
    f.zzweek,
    f.rcntr,
    f.zzscode,
    s.strnum,
    s.rep_mkt_code,
    s.rep_mkt_desc,
    s.city,
    s.state,
    s.division_code,
    s.division_desc,
    s.area_code,
    s.area_desc,
    s.region_code,
    s.region_desc,
    s.district_code,
    s.district_desc,
    s.emerg_mkt_ind,
    s.fs_open_dat,
    s.rx_open_dat,
    s.rx_division_code,
    s.rx_area_code,
    s.rx_region_code,
    s.rx_district_code
  FROM Joined_FAGLSKF_with_HIER f
  LEFT JOIN STORE_ATTR_SKF_JOURNAL_ENT s
    ON f.prctr = s.prctr
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 6: COMP_FLAG_SKF_JOURNAL_ENT
-- Logic: Projects comparison flag master data from ZTSRP_COMPFL.
--        Applies client filter from CV_BASE_MD_COMPFL_S4 and the
--        consumer parameter filter COMP_VER = @ip_version_comp_flag.
--        Note: CV_BASE_MD_COMPFL_S4 uses MANDT IN (110,200); the
--        consumer filter $$IP_VERSION_COMP_FLAG$$ is applied here.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_compfl
-- Filters: mandt IN ('110','200') [STRING per BQ_DATATYPE]
--          comp_ver = @ip_version_comp_flag [STRING]
-- =====================================================================
COMP_FLAG_SKF_JOURNAL_ENT AS (
  SELECT
    prctr,
    strnum,
    comp_ver,
    zweek,
    zmonth,
    zyear,
    fs_comp_wk,
    rx_comp_wk
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_compfl`
  WHERE mandt IN ('110', '200')
    AND comp_ver = @ip_version_comp_flag
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 7: Joined_StoreAttr_with_CompFlag
-- Logic: LEFT OUTER JOIN of Joined_FAGLSKF_HIER_with_STORE_ATTR and
--        COMP_FLAG_SKF_JOURNAL_ENT on prctr AND zzweek = zweek,
--        as defined by Join_3 in CV_COMP_SKF_MANUAL_JE.
-- Source: Joined_FAGLSKF_HIER_with_STORE_ATTR, COMP_FLAG_SKF_JOURNAL_ENT
-- Join: LEFT JOIN on j.prctr = c.prctr AND j.zzweek = c.zweek
-- =====================================================================
Joined_StoreAttr_with_CompFlag AS (
  SELECT
    j.rclnt,
    j.stagr,
    j.date_from,
    j.msl,
    j.prctr,
    j.zzweek,
    j.rcntr,
    j.zzscode,
    j.strnum,
    j.rep_mkt_code,
    j.rep_mkt_desc,
    j.city,
    j.state,
    j.division_code,
    j.division_desc,
    j.area_code,
    j.area_desc,
    j.region_code,
    j.region_desc,
    j.district_code,
    j.district_desc,
    j.emerg_mkt_ind,
    j.fs_open_dat,
    j.rx_open_dat,
    j.rx_division_code,
    j.rx_area_code,
    j.rx_region_code,
    j.rx_district_code,
    c.fs_comp_wk,
    c.rx_comp_wk
  FROM Joined_FAGLSKF_HIER_with_STORE_ATTR j
  LEFT JOIN COMP_FLAG_SKF_JOURNAL_ENT c
    ON j.prctr = c.prctr
    AND j.zzweek = c.zweek
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 8: CAL_WEEK
-- Logic: Projects fiscal calendar week data from ZTFIGL_RCALWEEK.
--        Applies client filter from CV_BASE_MD_RCALWEEK_S4. Only
--        columns consumed downstream are projected.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztfigl_rcalweek
-- Filters: rclnt IN ('120','200') [STRING per BQ_DATATYPE]
-- =====================================================================
CAL_WEEK AS (
  SELECT
    zzweek,
    zrwstrtdate,
    zrwenddate
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztfigl_rcalweek`
  WHERE rclnt IN ('120', '200')
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 9: Joined_with_CAL_WEEK
-- Logic: LEFT OUTER JOIN of Joined_StoreAttr_with_CompFlag and
--        CAL_WEEK on zzweek, as defined by Join_6 in
--        CV_COMP_SKF_MANUAL_JE.
-- Source: Joined_StoreAttr_with_CompFlag, CAL_WEEK
-- Join: LEFT JOIN on j.zzweek = c.zzweek
-- =====================================================================
Joined_with_CAL_WEEK AS (
  SELECT
    j.rclnt,
    j.stagr,
    j.date_from,
    j.msl,
    j.prctr,
    j.zzweek,
    j.rcntr,
    j.zzscode,
    j.strnum,
    j.rep_mkt_code,
    j.rep_mkt_desc,
    j.city,
    j.state,
    j.division_code,
    j.division_desc,
    j.area_code,
    j.area_desc,
    j.region_code,
    j.region_desc,
    j.district_code,
    j.district_desc,
    j.emerg_mkt_ind,
    j.fs_open_dat,
    j.rx_open_dat,
    j.rx_division_code,
    j.rx_area_code,
    j.rx_region_code,
    j.rx_district_code,
    j.fs_comp_wk,
    j.rx_comp_wk,
    c.zrwstrtdate,
    c.zrwenddate
  FROM Joined_StoreAttr_with_CompFlag j
  LEFT JOIN CAL_WEEK c
    ON j.zzweek = c.zzweek
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 10: PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT
-- Logic: Projects profit center text descriptions from CEPCT.
--        Applies client filter from CV_BASE_MD_CEPCT_S4. Maps LTEXT
--        as profit_center_text per the consumer output contract.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_cepct
-- Filters: mandt IN ('120','200') [STRING per BQ_DATATYPE]
-- =====================================================================
PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT AS (
  SELECT
    prctr,
    ltext AS profit_center_text
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_cepct`
  WHERE mandt IN ('120', '200')
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 11: SKF_QTY
-- Logic: Final projection node from CV_COMP_SKF_MANUAL_JE. Joins
--        Joined_with_CAL_WEEK with PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT on prctr (Join_8,
--        LEFT OUTER JOIN). Computes all calculated columns:
--          cal_msl: CASE WHEN stagr='801000' THEN msl ELSE msl*2 END
--          cal_week_number: RIGHT(CAST(zzweek AS STRING), 2)
--          cal_comp_flag: rx_comp_wk
--        All raw and calculated columns are projected for the final
--        aggregation step.
-- Source: Joined_with_CAL_WEEK, PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT
-- Join: LEFT JOIN on j.prctr = p.prctr
-- Calculation: cal_msl, cal_week_number, cal_comp_flag
-- =====================================================================
SKF_QTY AS (
  SELECT
    j.rclnt,
    j.stagr,
    j.date_from,
    j.msl,
    j.prctr,
    j.zzweek,
    j.rcntr,
    j.zzscode,
    j.strnum,
    j.rep_mkt_code,
    j.rep_mkt_desc,
    j.city,
    j.state,
    j.division_code,
    j.division_desc,
    j.area_code,
    j.area_desc,
    j.region_code,
    j.region_desc,
    j.district_code,
    j.district_desc,
    j.emerg_mkt_ind,
    j.fs_open_dat,
    j.rx_open_dat,
    j.rx_division_code,
    j.rx_area_code,
    j.rx_region_code,
    j.rx_district_code,
    j.fs_comp_wk,
    j.rx_comp_wk,
    j.zrwstrtdate,
    j.zrwenddate,
    p.profit_center_text,
    -- Calculated columns (CV_COMP_SKF_MANUAL_JE SKF_QTY node)
    CASE WHEN j.stagr = '801000' THEN j.msl ELSE j.msl * 2 END AS cal_msl,
    RIGHT(CAST(j.zzweek AS STRING), 2)                          AS cal_week_number,
    j.rx_comp_wk                                                AS cal_comp_flag
  FROM Joined_with_CAL_WEEK j
  LEFT JOIN PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT p
    ON j.prctr = p.prctr
)

-- =====================================================================
-- FINAL SELECT
-- Logic: Aggregation node of CV_COMP_SKF_MANUAL_JE (CUBE / Aggregation).
--        SUM(cal_msl) AS msl over all non-measure GROUP BY columns.
--        cal_comp_flag is output as comp_flag per the consumer output
--        contract alias. zzscode is output as source_code per the
--        consumer output contract alias defined in the join projection.
-- Aggregation: SUM(cal_msl) AS msl
-- =====================================================================
SELECT
  emerg_mkt_ind,
  district_desc,
  district_code,
  region_desc,
  region_code,
  area_desc,
  area_code,
  division_desc,
  division_code,
  state,
  city,
  rep_mkt_desc,
  rep_mkt_code,
  zzweek,
  prctr,
  date_from,
  stagr,
  rclnt,
  fs_comp_wk,
  rx_comp_wk,
  zrwstrtdate,
  zrwenddate,
  rcntr,
  profit_center_text,
  fs_open_dat,
  rx_open_dat,
  cal_week_number,
  cal_comp_flag                AS comp_flag,
  strnum,
  zzscode                      AS source_code,
  rx_division_code,
  rx_area_code,
  rx_region_code,
  rx_district_code,
  SUM(cal_msl)                 AS msl
FROM SKF_QTY
GROUP BY
  emerg_mkt_ind,
  district_desc,
  district_code,
  region_desc,
  region_code,
  area_desc,
  area_code,
  division_desc,
  division_code,
  state,
  city,
  rep_mkt_desc,
  rep_mkt_code,
  zzweek,
  prctr,
  date_from,
  stagr,
  rclnt,
  fs_comp_wk,
  rx_comp_wk,
  zrwstrtdate,
  zrwenddate,
  rcntr,
  profit_center_text,
  fs_open_dat,
  rx_open_dat,
  cal_week_number,
  cal_comp_flag,
  strnum,
  zzscode,
  rx_division_code,
  rx_area_code,
  rx_region_code,
  rx_district_code
;
